items.reason: FLT_LOG_LEN=16 controls flt_log length: `static unsigned char flt_log[FLT_LOG_LEN];` and is used with masking `flt_idx++ & (FLT_LOG_LEN - 1)` to wrap the fault-code ring buffer. Unit interpreted as buffer entries/bytes.
k_trip_a=15.0f is the slow overload RMS trip threshold used as `if (i_rms > k_trip_a)`; comment says `/* A rms, overload trip */`. It triggers `inv_off()` after a hold time.

ol_hold_ms=5000 is the overload ride-through/hold threshold used with 1 ms ticks: `if (++ol_ms >= ol_hold_ms) { inv_off(); ... }` where ol_ms is decremented otherwise. Thus it is the time above the RMS trip before overload action.

Inline constant 21.2f is used in `prot_fast(float i_pk)` as `if (a > 21.2f) { inv_off(); log_fault(FLT_OC); }` where `a` is abs(i_pk). It is a fast per-cycle peak-current threshold for over-current shutdown. No direct mapping guarantee to iout_pk_limit without knowing the sense range, but it is the only hardware-like peak limit in this file.

Inline constant 0.9f appears as `if (vo_rms < 0.9f * VO_NOM) { log_fault(FLT_BRN); }` indicating a brownout warning boundary relative to VO_NOM. It is an operating window/edge (warning/fault logging), not a trip level defined by a named spec rule.
Inline constant 3 is the retry limit in `prot_restart()` as `if (retry < 3) { ... retry++; ... }` controlling restart attempts. It's not a physical trip/setpoint/timing spec quantity.
Inline constant 500 is used in `delay_ms(500);` before retrying `inv_on()`. It is an explicit restart delay in milliseconds.
FW_VER_MAJ on line 19 is the firmware major version identifier (hand-typed literal 2).
VIN_LO_XFER on line 22 is the AC input transfer-down threshold (Vrms) below which the UPS goes to battery; literal 85.0f. Maps to vin_min.
VIN_HI_XFER on line 23 is the AC input transfer-up threshold (Vrms) above which the UPS goes to battery transfer/bypass to AC; literal 265.0f. Maps to vin_max.
VBUS_REF on line 26 is PFC regulation target, labeled as DC bus regulation target (V), literal 400.0f. Closest rule by meaning is vbus_set, though spec mentions rounding up to 10 V; not stated here.
VO_NOM on line 29 is output nominal voltage in Vrms (setpoint); literal 220.0f. Maps to vout_set (RMS).

VO_TOL on line 30 defines the +/- regulation band as a tolerance (unitless fraction 0.03). By itself it is not a rule edge; combined with VO_NOM it determines vout_hi/vout_lo. Mapped as vout_hi indirectly only due to usage context; otherwise null would fit VO_TOL.
VO_HI on line 31 is computed as VO_NOM*(1.0f+VO_TOL), giving upper edge of output regulation band; maps to vout_hi. Not hand-typed literal because it is derived from other macros.
IO_RATED on line 32 is rated output current (A rms) 12.5f. Maps to iout_rated.
I_TRIP_RMS on line 33 is overload shutdown trip level (A rms) literal 14.0f. Maps to iout_trip (software overload trip level).
TMR_LD on line 36 is PWM period register (counts) for 25 kHz carrier; literal 6000. Maps to pwm_period.
DB_CNT on line 37 is dead-time register (counts) described as 300 us dead time; literal 30. Maps to pwm_deadband.
K_P on line 40 is voltage loop proportional gain coefficient; literal 0.8f. Maps to vloop_kp.
K_I on line 41 is voltage loop integral gain per control ISR; literal 0.015f. Maps to vloop_ki.
VBAT_NOM on line 44 is battery string nominal voltage, literal 89.6f. Maps to vbat_nom.
VBAT_CUT on line 45 is end-of-discharge / low-battery shutdown voltage, literal 78.4f. Maps to vbat_cutoff.
UART_BAUD on line 48 is UART/RS-232 baud rate, literal 19200. No spec rule provided for UART baud.
PIN_BYP_RELAY on line 49 is GPIO pin assignment for static bypass relay drive; literal 12. Maps to no listed spec rule.
ADC_FULL (line 9) defines the ADC full-scale code for the sense chain; it is used as the ADC denominator for scaling.
DAC_FULL (line 10) defines the comparator reference DAC full-scale code; used to derive the negative trip DAC code.
VBUS_FS (line 13) is labeled as 'V at ADC full scale' for the DC bus divider, directly matching vbus_fs.
K_VS (line 14) is computed as (VBUS_FS / ADC_FULL) 'V per count', matching the volts-per-ADC-count rule vbus_scale.
VBAT_FS (line 17) is labeled 'V at ADC full scale' for the battery divider, matching vbat_fs.
VO_FS_PK (line 20) is labeled 'peak V at +/- half scale' for the mid-rail biased output voltage sensing, matching the peak at the edge of the mid-rail biased sense range (vout_fs_pk).
IO_FS_PK (line 23) is labeled 'peak A at +/- half scale' for the mid-rail biased output current sense range, matching iout_fs_pk.
CMP_DAC_HI (line 24) is 'positive overcurrent trip code' for the comparator DAC; corresponds to the positive hardware peak-current limit DAC code (iout_pklim_dac_hi).
CMP_DAC_LO (line 25) is computed as (DAC_FULL - CMP_DAC_HI) and labeled as the negative overcurrent trip code; corresponds to iout_pklim_dac_lo.
